_readme: Chapter names for the four migrated Thinkific courses, keyed by course id then chapter index.
Why this file is hand-written rather than generated: the Thinkific -> Bunny migration
manifests (migration-notes/*-video-map.json) only captured contentId, key, title, seconds
and filename per LESSON. The chapter each lesson belongs to survived only as the number in
its key (c1-l3 = chapter 1), never as a name — so there is nothing to generate a name from.
The names below were written from the lessons each chapter actually contains. Replace any of
them with the exact chapter title from Thinkific and it shows up verbatim in the sidebar, the
course page and the calendar. A chapter with no entry here falls back to 'บทที่ N'.
Reading is the weak one: its manifest lost most lesson titles too, so those names are read off
the handful that survived. Worth checking against Thinkific first.
Writing is absent on purpose — it has real chapter names in src/writingCourseCurriculum.ts.
